item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29652

❗️
CSTO exercises started at Chebarkulskiy training ground
Joint command post and special exercises of CSTO Collective Rapid Reaction Forces Cooperation 2026, Search 2026 and Echelon 2026 were started in the Russian Federation.
▫️
Colonel General Andrei Serdyukov, Chief of the CSTO Joint Staff, Deputy Secretary General of the Organisation Mirlan Turgunbekov, and military contingents commanders took part in the opening ceremony.
💬
Addressing the participants of the exercise, Chief of the CSTO Joint Staff Andrei Serdyukov noted that
high-quality organisation of joint operational and combat training, taking into account the experience of modern armed conflicts, as well as the development of the combat potential of the CSTO Collective Forces, their equipping with modern weapons, military and special hardware, including unmanned systems, reconnaissance means, and electronic warfare systems, and the improvement of the air defence system organisation
are priority directions of activity during the Russian Federation's chairmanship of the Organisation.
‘The urgency of this is due to the extremely difficult military and political situation in the world. The further degradation of international relations, as well as the ‘zones of instability’ approaching the borders of our states, contribute to the growth of challenges and threats to military security. The prevailing conditions dictate us that we must promptly react to changes of the combat operations' nature. Guided by our priorities, we are refining the command elements and formations of the Collective Forces, and their readiness for operations that replicate as closely as possible the real conditions of modern armed conflicts,' said Colonel General Andrei Serdyukov.
✅
‘I am sure that
our exercises will serve to further improvement and the readiness increasing of the Collective Forces to perform their tasks, will demonstrate the determination of the Organisation and the force component's readiness to ensure collective security
,’ the Chief of the CSTO Joint Staff noted.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 27 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one Unmanned Systems Forces assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, four national guard brigades, and the Azov special forces brigade close to Belozerskoye, Malotaranovka, Andreyevka, Maryevka, Verovka, Pervomayskoye (Donetsk People's Republic), Novopavlovka, and Chuguyevo (Dnepropetrovsk region).
⚡️
In the settlement of Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Combined Arms Army
carried out offensive operations in the north-western direction
and, cooperating with marine units, continued to deliver strikes at the AFU's encircled units in the west and east areas of the city. More than 30 militants have been neutralised, and 94 buildings have been mopped up. Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has not attempted to break out of the encirclement.
▪️
In total, up to 420 troops, four Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade close to Pokrovskoye, Gavrilovka, Orly, Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Tarasovka, Yegorovka, and Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 290 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Malokaterinovka, Novoyakovlevka, Kirovo, Kamyshevakha, Orekhov, and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 45 troops, 19 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
transport, fuel and power infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, manufacturing workshops producing unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 149 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
four guided aerial bombs, one HIMARS-made MLRS projectile, and 505 fixed-wing UAVs.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
246,847
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,044
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,781
MLRS vehicles,
▫️
36,574
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
72,994
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29650

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces
continue to tighten the encirclements of the AFU formations
in the north-east of Kharkov region
and expand the external control zone.
🚩
As a result of active offensive actions,
control has been established over the settlement of Khripuny
(Kharkov region).
📍
Combat operations are conducted to liberate
Nesternoye, Lukashovo, and Grachovka. Formations of the enemy are being destroyed close to the settlements of Varvarovka and Rublenoye (Kharkov region).
🔥
Russian troops
thwarted two enemy's attempts to escape from the encirclement
near Nefedovka (Kharkov region).
▪️
During the day, the enemy lost up to 60 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, one motor vehicle, one ATV, and two ground robotic systems.
📍
While expanding the external control zone,
the combat actions are underway for the liberation of Prikolotnoye
(Kharkov region).
💥
In addition,
in Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one unmanned systems brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one territorial defence brigade near Kupino, Fedorovka, Zhovtnevoye, and Maly Burluk (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region,
strikes were delivered at
formations of four mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two territorial defence brigades, and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine near Sukhodol, Sumy, Khoten, Kiyanitsa, and Velikaya Rybitsa (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, more than 300 troops, one T-72 tank, one U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carrier, one Tisa armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, and four electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one territorial defence brigade, and one national guard brigade close to Shevchenkovo, Pervomayskoye, Maleyevka (Kharkov region), Donetskoye, Lozovoye, Rubtsy, Karpovka, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 230 troops, 12 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of five mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade have been hit near Druzhkovka, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Kramatorsk, Klinovoye, Krasny Molochar, and Nikonorovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 230 troops, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, 28 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💥 Air defence systems in action! Flamingo destroyed! On the night of 19–20 September, Moscow region
item.description: 💥 Air defence systems in action! Flamingo destroyed! 📍 On the night of 19–20 September, Moscow region A crew leader of the Pantsir-S SAM system with call sign Barnaul told about the air battle 👇 🎯 Late at night, a mark flashed up on the combat vehicle's screen indicating a high-speed target. The crew destroyed it without any doubts: they locked on it, identified the object's type, a cruise missile, and eliminated the air threat. It was the Barnaul's crew that shot down three Flamingo missiles – the first such instance in the entire history of enemy raids on Moscow! 📊 In total, 1,600 air targets were shot down by air defence crews that night, including eight Flamingo high-speed cruise missiles. Go on, comrades! ▫️ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
